name: Deuces and Jacks and the Man with the Axe
description: Deuces and Jacks and the Man with the Axe: 7-card stud variant where all 2s, all Jacks, and the King of Diamonds ('the man with the axe') are wild. Same deal as 7-card stud; many wilds create very strong hands. USA; dealer's choice.
alsoKnownAs: Deuces and Jacks and the Man with the Axe Poker

overview.description: Deuces and Jacks and the Man with the Axe: 7-card stud variant where all 2s, all Jacks, and the King of Diamonds ('the man with the axe') are wild. Same deal as 7-card stud; many wilds create very strong hands. USA; dealer's choice.

history.origins: American 7-card stud wild variant; Deuces, Jacks, and King of Diamonds wild. Name refers to the King of Diamonds figure.

setup.players: From 2 to 8 players can take part, using a standard 52-pack. The game is best for 5 to 7 players; with 8 players the deck may run out towards the end of the deal.
setup.dealing: Same as 7-card stud. All 2s, all Jacks, and the King of Diamonds are wild.

rules.objective: Make the best five-card poker hand from seven cards; 2s, Jacks, and the King of Diamonds are wild.
rules.gameplay: Betting as in 7-card stud. At showdown, each 2, each Jack, and the King of Diamonds substitute for any card; use any five of seven for best hand.
keyRules: King of Diamonds is wild ('the man with the axe')

strategy.basic: With many wilds, straights and flushes are common; play for full houses and quads.
strategy.intermediate: Track exposed wilds; 2s, Jacks, and the King of Diamonds total 13 wild cards in deck.
strategy.advanced: Variant-specific bluffing and hand-reading with high wild density.

variations.emptyOverridesReason: No documented variants beyond the standard wild-card rules; placeholder for future additions.

scoring.description: Highest five-card poker hand wins after applying wild card substitutions.
scoring.winCondition: Win by making the strongest eligible five-card hand from seven cards.

sources.name: Pagat.com - 7-Card Stud Variants (Deuces & Jacks & the Man with the Axe)

synthesis.shortDescription: A seven-card stud wild-card variant where deuces, jacks, and the king of diamonds can stand in for any rank.

hero.title: DEUCES, JACKS, AXE
hero.subtitle: Wild Card Stud
hero.tagline: When half the deck is wild, reading the table matters more than odds.
